name: popup-flat
summary: One-line OSD popups (No signal, input name, ...) as one see-through gray box with white centred text, without the empty header band

notes: sub_256C92 paints rows 0/1 of every small popup with the menu header band (attribute 0x11 and the half-tile glyph 2) although only state 0x19 places text there. For the one-line popups (states 2/4, 8/9/0x0C) the patch fills the whole window with the band colour (0x11), draws the message as white on that colour (0x21) and moves it to the middle row (input popups 20x4 -> 20x3). States 3/5 keep the near-black body without the band; state 0x19 is unchanged. Cosmetic only. popup-round hooks the jump at label gray_done (0x203c30). Generated by tools/patches_src_popup_flat.py.
